mapper.insert: INSERT INTO federated_tasks (id, name, algorithm, status, total_rounds, current_round, config) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{algorithm}, #{status}, #{totalRounds}, #{currentRound}, CAST(#{config} AS JSON)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), algorithm = VALUES(algorithm), status = VALUES(status), total_rounds = VALUES(total_rounds), current_round = VALUES(current_round), config = VALUES(config)
mapper.update: UPDATE federated_tasks SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, algorithm, status, total_rounds, current_round, config, created_at, updated_at FROM federated_tasks WHERE id = #{id}
